name: Legendary Bull Gator
region: Lemoyne — Bayou Nwa, just west of Lakay
landmark: The swamp shore just west of Lakay
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Enter the territory until the game says you have entered Legendary Animal Territory, then follow the clue trail. If riders or another event are crowding the swamp, sleep and come back. It does not respawn.
unlock: The other legendary hunts open after the Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, when Hosea gives you an incomplete Legendary Animal Map. For this gator, the Red Dead Wiki says you must finish the Chapter 6 mission That's Murfree Country first. Older guides named the Chapter 4 mission Country Pursuits instead. Treat that gate as conflicting: ride to Lakay and trust the on-screen territory notice.
weapon: A rifle with express rounds is the practical choice. Improved arrows also work. Pelt quality is not graded, so the weapon does not change the pelt.
ammo: Express rifle rounds, or improved arrows. One clean kill is enough.
reward: Alligator Tooth Talisman at a Fence: Dead Eye core drains about 10% slower. It also takes Vintage Civil War Handcuffs and a Gold Jointed Bracelet. Fence price on IGN's trinket list is $40. The pelt can also be made into unique Trapper clothing. Every Trapper shares the same stock; this guide does not invent garment names. Gus's legendary-animal maps are Red Dead Online only.

name: Legendary Beaver
region: New Hanover — a pond due west of Van Horn
landmark: The northern shore of the pond west of Van Horn Trading Post, where the water connects to the river
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Enter the territory, follow about three clue sets, and skin it once. If the area is busy, camp and return. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego. Hosea gives the incomplete Legendary Animal Map. The pelt is sent to the Trapper if you lose it. Skinning completes the study.
weapon: A rifle is simpler than chasing it in the water. Pelt quality is not graded.
ammo: Express or regular rifle rounds. Any fatal shot keeps the legendary pelt.
reward: Beaver Tooth Trinket at a Fence: weapon degradation is about 10% slower. IGN lists the craft price at $18.25. The pelt is also used for unique Trapper clothing, shared by every Trapper.

name: Legendary Bharati Grizzly
region: Ambarino — Grizzlies East, just north and west of O'Creagh's Run
landmark: The woods just northwest of O'Creagh's Run
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. You meet this bear during Hosea's hunting mission and can leave without killing it, then return later and follow the clues. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego. That mission takes you into the territory. You can abandon the hunt and come back after the mission.
weapon: Rifle with express rounds, or improved arrows. Do not use a small sidearm if you can help it. Pelt quality is not graded.
ammo: Express rifle rounds or improved arrows.
reward: Bear Claw Talisman at a Fence: Health core drains about 10% slower. It also takes a Silver Chain Bracelet and a Quartz Chunk. IGN lists $34.75. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Bighorn Ram
region: Ambarino — between the Dakota River and Cattail Pond, outside Valentine
landmark: The high ground west of Valentine, with the Dakota River to the east and Cattail Pond to the west
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Enter the territory and follow the clues. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, then Hosea's Legendary Animal Map.
weapon: A rifle is enough. Pelt quality is not graded.
ammo: Rifle rounds. A scoped rifle helps if it is still on the ridge.
reward: Ram Horn Trinket at a Fence: picking thyme, oregano, or mint gives double. IGN lists $17.50. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Boar
region: Lemoyne — Bluewater Marsh, east side of the Kamassa River
landmark: The east bank of the Kamassa River in Bluewater Marsh
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Follow the clues after the territory notice. This is not the huge boar at the end of Hamish Sinclair's Veteran missions. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, then Hosea's Legendary Animal Map.
weapon: Rifle. It charges, so leave yourself room. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Boar Tusk Talisman at a Fence: your horse's Health and Stamina cores drain about 10% slower. It also takes a Gold Earring and Cobalt Petrified Wood. IGN lists $31. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Buck
region: West Elizabeth — Big Valley, west of Mount Shann and north of Lake Owanjila
landmark: The valley due west of Mount Shann and due north of Lake Owanjila
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Follow the clues after the territory notice. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, then Hosea's Legendary Animal Map.
weapon: Rifle or a poison arrow. Pelt quality is not graded on the legendary.
ammo: Rifle rounds, or one poison arrow.
reward: Buck Antler Trinket at a Fence: skinned animals are more likely to keep a higher pelt quality. IGN lists $22. This is the trinket that helps ordinary 3-star pelts. The legendary pelt is also used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Cougar
region: New Austin — Gaptooth Ridge, due west of Tumbleweed
landmark: The rocks due west of Tumbleweed
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. In a normal story playthrough this part of the map opens in the epilogue. Follow the clues after the territory notice. It does not respawn.
unlock: Hosea's map from Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, plus epilogue access to New Austin. The main chapters lock this region.
weapon: Rifle with express rounds. It ambushes. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Cougar Fang Trinket at a Fence: about 10% more stamina experience. IGN lists the ingredient as the fang and the price as $20.50. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Coyote
region: Lemoyne — just outside Eris Field, due south of Dewberry Creek
landmark: The fields just outside Eris Field, south of Dewberry Creek
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Follow the clues after the territory notice. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, then Hosea's Legendary Animal Map.
weapon: Rifle or repeater. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Coyote Fang Trinket at a Fence: about 10% more Dead Eye experience. IGN lists $21.25. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Elk
region: New Hanover — Cumberland Forest, just east of Bacchus Station
landmark: The forest just east of Bacchus Station
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. This is New Hanover, not Ambarino. Follow the clues after the territory notice. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, then Hosea's Legendary Animal Map.
weapon: Rifle, preferably at range before it bolts. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Elk Antler Trinket at a Fence: about 10% more money from looting. IGN lists $22.75. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Fox
region: Lemoyne — near Mattock Pond, due north of Rhodes
landmark: The country around Mattock Pond, north of Rhodes
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Follow the clues after the territory notice. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, then Hosea's Legendary Animal Map.
weapon: Rifle or repeater. A scoped shot is easier before it runs. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Fox Claw Trinket at a Fence: Eagle Eye lasts about 5 seconds longer. IGN lists $23.50. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Moose
region: New Hanover — Roanoke Ridge, near Brandywine Drop on the Kamassa River
landmark: The Kamassa River country beside Brandywine Drop
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. This is New Hanover, not Ambarino. Follow the clues after the territory notice. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, then Hosea's Legendary Animal Map.
weapon: Rifle with express rounds. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Moose Antler Trinket at a Fence: about 10% more health experience. IGN lists $19. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Panther (Giaguaro)
region: Lemoyne — south of Rhodes, at Bolger Glade
landmark: Bolger Glade, south of Rhodes. Some older guides misspell it Bolder Blade.
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. It will not spawn until Master Hunter challenges 1 through 9 are done. This hunt is Master Hunter 10. Follow the clues after the territory notice. It does not respawn.
unlock: Finish Master Hunter 1 through 9 first. The challenge list itself tells you what rank 9 requires; this guide does not restate a task that was not rechecked. Hosea's map alone is not enough.
weapon: Rifle with express rounds. It closes distance fast. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Panther's Eye Trinket at a Fence: Dead Eye drains about 10% slower for 3 seconds. IGN lists $25. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Pronghorn
region: New Austin — Rio Bravo, due west of Rio del Lobo Rock
landmark: The plain due west of Rio del Lobo Rock
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Normal story access is the epilogue, because New Austin is locked before then. It does not respawn.
unlock: Hosea's map from Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, plus epilogue access to New Austin.
weapon: Rifle. It spooks at long range. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Pronghorn Horn Trinket at a Fence: animal carcasses stowed on your horse no longer spoil. IGN lists $24.50. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Tatanka Bison
region: New Austin — Hennigan's Stead, southeast of MacFarlane's Ranch and south of Stillwater Creek
landmark: The plain southeast of MacFarlane's Ranch, south of Stillwater Creek
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Normal story access is the epilogue. This is not the Red Dead Online Tatanka near Heartland Overflow, and it is not Hamish Sinclair's homestead. It does not respawn.
unlock: Hosea's map from Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, plus epilogue access to New Austin. Online's Naturalist Tatanka is a different animal.
weapon: Rifle with express rounds. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Tatanka Bison Horn Trinket at a Fence: melee damage taken is reduced by about 10%. IGN lists $16.75. Do not confuse this with the White Bison's Bison Horn Talisman. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary White Bison
region: Ambarino — northeastern shore of Lake Isabella, due west of Barrow Lagoon
landmark: The snowy northeastern shore of Lake Isabella
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. Follow the clues on the ice and the shore. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, then Hosea's Legendary Animal Map. Lake Isabella is reachable during Chapter 2.
weapon: Rifle with express rounds. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Bison Horn Talisman at a Fence: Stamina core drains about 10% slower. It also takes an Abalone Shell Fragment and a Silver Earring. IGN lists $38.50. This is the White Bison reward, not the Tatanka trinket. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.

name: Legendary Wolf
region: Ambarino — north side of the Dakota River around Cotorra Springs
landmark: The north bank of the Dakota River around Cotorra Springs
conditions: No fixed clock is confirmed. The wolf is not alone; deal with the pack. It does not respawn.
unlock: Chapter 2 mission Exit, Pursued by a Bruised Ego, then Hosea's Legendary Animal Map.
weapon: Rifle or repeater. Pelt quality is not graded.
reward: Wolf Heart Trinket at a Fence: you can drink about twice as much alcohol before drunk penalties. IGN lists $16. The pelt is used for unique Trapper clothing.
